title: Day 7/28 - Terraform Type Constraints (simply explained)
description:
Welcome to 7/28 day of Terraform Full Course For Beginners
In this video, we will explore the critical role of type constraints in maintaining robust Infrastructure as Code.

⭐️ Below topics will be covered in this video:
- Primitive Types (string, number, boolean): Essential building blocks for variable validation
- Complex Data Structures: Implementing maps, sets, and lists for dynamic resource configuration
- Advanced Patterns: Leveraging tuples and objects for strict type enforcement

Type constraints have been explained from a beginner's perspective with the help of real-time examples of how exactly it is used in an enterprise infrastructure as a code setup.
